ma.getBLEDeviceServices(Object object)

Get all services of Bluetooth low energy devices (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
deviceId String Yes Bluetooth device id. The connection needs to have been established via ma.createBLEConnection.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getBLEDeviceServices: ok
services Array Device service list

Array services

Object ArrayItem
Attribute Type Description
uuid String UUID of the Bluetooth device service
isPrimary Boolean Whether the service is the main service

Sample Code

ma.getBLEDeviceServices({
  deviceId,
  success: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'getBLEDeviceService success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
    for (let i = 0; i < res.services.length; i++) {
      if (res.services[i].isPrimary) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(res.services[i]));
        return
      }
    }
  },
  fail: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'getBLEDeviceService fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
})
